How it works

No SDK rewrite. No DevOps. Three steps to clear AI margins.

1
~2 minutes

Generate your API key

Sign up, get your obs_live_... key in under two minutes. No credit card required for the free tier.

2
~5 lines of code

Drop in one background call

After each AI response, fire a single fetch() to our endpoint — it never blocks your users and never touches your AI traffic.

Everything you need

One dashboard. Every AI metric that matters.

Cost breakdown by customer, feature & endpoint

Latency & error monitoring

Built for

The lightweight option for AI builders

Indie hackers, solo SaaS founders, and small teams shipping AI features without a dedicated data engineering stack.

AI Observly is for you if…

  • You're a solo founder or small team shipping AI features
  • You're using OpenAI, Anthropic, or any major LLM provider
  • You want to know if your AI costs are eating your margins

How we compare

Tools like Langfuse, Helicone, and Datadog are powerful — but they're built for engineering teams. We're the plain-English option for founders who just want to know if their AI is making money.
